column3: Follow-up on the existing refcam "pier_night" (tools/refcams/cameras.json): it still measures far too dark (luminance p50 ~21) and reads as a black frame with a few lit dots. Make it read like a 2026 AAA night shot of a lit amusement pier from the beach: the wheel, the stands, the deck lamps and their light on the water and the sand, people visible, sky not crushed. Fix exposure/lighting balance without blowing out other night cameras (run the ten refcams before and after).

Follow-up on refcam "refinery_night" (tools/refcams/cameras_w6.json): the access road in the foreground reads far too bright / flat grey against the dark plant. Make the road, verge and fence read as real wet-ish night asphalt lit only by what actually lights it (flares, masts), then fix 2-3 more things that most separate the shot from a 2026 AAA game.

New reference view "metro_station": inside the Coral Line's underground terminus (MetroStation, 7th St), on the platform with a train dwelling, doors open, riders. Add ONE row to tools/refcams/cameras_w7.json, judge against a 2026 AAA game, fix the worst 3-5 things.

New reference view "stack_aerial": the four-level freeway stack (FreewayStack, 110 x 101) from ~150 m up at 17:30 clear, traffic on every level. Add ONE row to tools/refcams/cameras_w7.json, judge, fix the worst 3-5 things.

New reference view "bonfire_night": the beach at 21:00 clear at eye level among the bonfire rings (Bonfires, BONFIRE_LIT=1 if needed) with groups around them, the surf and the pier lights beyond. Add ONE row to tools/refcams/cameras_w7.json, judge, fix the worst 3-5 things.

New reference view "canals_day": Marisol Canals at 11:00 clear, standing on a footbridge looking down a canal: houses fronting the water, boats, docks, reflections. Add ONE row to tools/refcams/cameras_w7.json, judge, fix the worst 3-5 things.

New reference view "film_lot": inside the SUNSPIRE PICTURES studio lot at 14:00 clear, eye level on a studio street between sound stages, the water tower, carts and crew. Add ONE row to tools/refcams/cameras_w7.json, judge, fix the worst 3-5 things.

New reference view "port_night": the container terminal at 22:00 clear from the quay, a working STS crane over the moored ship, floodlit yard, straddle carriers. Add ONE row to tools/refcams/cameras_w7.json, judge, fix the worst 3-5 things.
